variants.headline: Accident at a workplace
variants.sub: The colony has had an accident at a workplace.
variants.body:
An accident has occurred at a workplace in {colony}. The occurrence is established, while a particular injury or legal finding is not supplied here. Readers considering {target} should distinguish scrutiny of safety responsibility from an invented account of the accident's cause or the condition of those involved.

The role of {target} merits scrutiny against the accident. This paper does not presume a breach of rules or announce consequences for workers that have not been established in the reported particulars.

variants.headline: Workplace safety becomes immediate news
variants.sub: A workplace in the colony has been the scene of an accident.
variants.body:
Safety is a practical concern before it is a subject for a statement. A workplace accident has occurred in the colony. An assessment of {target} should take that event seriously without presuming the kind of work, the number affected or a breach of rules not established by this account.

The role of {target} merits scrutiny against the accident. This paper does not presume a breach of rules or announce consequences for workers that have not been established in the reported particulars.

variants.headline: An accident enters the working day
variants.sub: An accident has occurred at a workplace in {colony}.
variants.body:
The colony's news includes an accident at a workplace. That is sufficient reason for careful attention, not permission to imagine an injury or a rescue. For {target}, the relevant question is responsibility in the setting of work, with the known event kept distinct from its unreported particulars.

The role of {target} merits scrutiny against the accident. This paper does not presume a breach of rules or announce consequences for workers that have not been established in the reported particulars.
